units.title: Listening Part 4 – The Gray Wolf
units.instructions: Nghe và hoàn thành ghi chú (31–35), trả lời câu 36–38, và chọn HAI đáp án cho câu 39–40.
units.content: Nghe audio ở đầu trang và trả lời các câu hỏi bên dưới.

questions.prompt: Gray wolves are now found only in Canada, Alaska, Northern Eurasia and
options: A. many other places in the southern hemisphere
B. a few other isolated areas in the world
C. on the Indian subcontinent
questions.answer: B. a few other isolated areas in the world

questions.prompt: Supporters of the reintroduction program agreed to
options: A. give money to people whose cattle were at risk
B. delay restoring the wolf population for several years
C. fund more studies
questions.answer: A. give money to people whose cattle were at risk

questions.prompt: After reintroducing the wolves, biodiversity in Yellowstone Park increased and
options: A. maintained itself
B. fell soon afterwards
C. stayed exactly the same

questions.prompt: What are TWO results of the wolf reintroduction program in Yellowstone Park? (Question 39 — choose one of the two correct answers)
options: A. ranchers have become angry
B. there are fewer tourists in Yellowstone
C. eagle and hawk species have increased
D. Yellowstone is not as healthy as before
E. the local economy has benefitted
F. local population are fearful
answer: C. eagle and hawk species have increased
E. the local economy has benefitted

questions.prompt: What are TWO results of the wolf reintroduction program in Yellowstone Park? (Question 40 — choose the remaining correct answer)
options: A. ranchers have become angry
B. there are fewer tourists in Yellowstone
C. eagle and hawk species have increased
D. Yellowstone is not as healthy as before
E. the local economy has benefitted
F. local population are fearful
answer: C. eagle and hawk species have increased
E. the local economy has benefitted
